title: [DEV][NSC V3] Pod/Canula change not reported to NS
symptom: Pod and cannula changes are not reported to Nightscout (NS). The user switched from Insight to DASH and placed a new pod, but the pod change is not registered in NS. CAGE shows 4+ days from when using NSC V1. Manual entry via actions tab also does not work.
cause: The Nightscout server rejected the treatment upload with HTTP 400 error: 'Field date cannot be modified by the client'. This caused the upload to fail and the queue to stall, preventing subsequent records from being sent.
fix: The developer changed the processing to continue with upload when an error occurs, allowing subsequent records to be sent despite the faulty one.
evidence_quote: I changed processing to continue with upload when error occurs. Update
